device.model: MAUI oscilloscopes (WaveSurfer, HDO, MDA, WavePro, WaveRunner, SDA)
device.name: LeCroy MAUI oscilloscope (LeCroyScope)

facts.text: LeCroyScope is a VISA/SCPI interface for LeCroy oscilloscopes running MAUI firmware
Connection is lazy: __init__ stores the VISA resource string and connect() opens pyvisa.ResourceManager('@py') and the resource, sets a 10 s timeout and newline terminators, then queries *IDN?
The model is the second comma-separated field of the *IDN? reply
The model profile registry covers WaveSurfer, HDO, MDA, WavePro, WaveRunner and SDA families with 4 or 8 analog channels
get_capabilities returns the profile's channel count, bandwidth, ADC bits, coupling and bandwidth-limit values and math-channel count
get_channel_info queries <channel>:VDIV?, <channel>:OFST?, <channel>:CPL? (or COUP?), BWL?, <channel>:TRA? and, when the profile supports them, INVS? and UNIT?
set_vdiv writes <channel>:VDIV and set_offset writes <channel>:OFST
set_coupling and set_bwlimit validate the value against the detected profile before writing <channel>:CPL or <channel>:BWL
set_attenuation writes <channel>:ATTN
get_timebase_info queries TDIV?, TRDL? and MSIZ?
set_tdiv writes TDIV and set_trigger_delay writes TRDL
get_trigger_info queries TRIG_MODE?, TRIG_SELECT? and <channel>:TRIG_LEVEL? for every profile channel
set_trigger_mode validates against VALID_TRIG_MODES, set_trigger_source writes TRIG_SELECT EDGE,SR,...,SL,...,HT,OFF and set_trigger_level writes <channel>:TRIG_LEVEL
force_trigger writes FRTR, arm writes ARM and stop writes STOP
is_stopped queries TRMD? and reports True when the reply contains STOP
measure queries <channel>:PAVA? <parameter>; if the reply contains ',IV' it writes PACU 1,<parameter>,<channel> and queries again
calibrate queries *CAL? and returns the stripped reply
disconnect attempts to close the VISA instrument and resource manager, suppresses close errors, then clears the stored connections
get_date queries DATE?
COMM_HEADER defaults to SHORT; OFF omits response headers and suppresses units
The manual states the attenuation factors {1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 10000}
The manual states the coupling values {A1M, D1M, D50, GND}
The manual states the bandwidth-limit values {OFF, 20MHZ, 200MHZ, 500MHZ, 1GHZ, 2GHZ, 3GHZ, 4GHZ, 6GHZ}
The manual states the trigger modes {AUTO, NORM, SINGLE, STOP}
The manual refers the timebase range to the product datasheet and gives no numeric TDIV bound
The manual says the offset range depends on the fixed sensitivity and refers to the product datasheet
The manual says an out-of-range trigger level is adjusted to the closest legal value and gives no numeric bound
The manual gives the trigger delay range as 0 to -10,000 times Time/div for negative delay and 0 to +10 times Time/div for positive delay
The manual says the trigger sources available depend on the oscilloscope model
The manual lists the trigger source mnemonics C1...Cn, LINE, EX, EX5, EX10 and ETM10
The manual says *CAL? returns a diagnostic code where 0 means calibration successful and the example reply for no failure is '*CAL 0'
The manual gives the PAVA response format <parameter>,<value>,<state>
The manual says MEMORY_SIZE accepts a numeric size or the listed forms and the oscilloscope adapts to the closest valid memory size

operator_required.name: vdiv
operator_required.reason: the manual refers the valid VOLT_DIV range to the product datasheet (resources/maui_text.txt:4985) and the clone states no range (oscilloscope.py:462-463); the operator must supply the scale envelope of the fitted probe

operator_required.name: offset
operator_required.reason: the manual says the maximum offset depends on the fixed sensitivity (resources/maui_text.txt:4660) and the clone states no range; the operator must supply the offset window of this bench

operator_required.name: tdiv
operator_required.reason: the manual refers the timebase specifications to the product datasheet (resources/maui_text.txt:4744) and the clone states no range (oscilloscope.py:523-524); the operator must supply the timebase window of this bench

operator_required.name: trigger_source
operator_required.reason: the manual says the trigger sources available depend on the oscilloscope model (resources/maui_text.txt:4884) and lists C1...Cn, LINE, EX, EX5, EX10 and ETM10 (resources/maui_text.txt:4914-4920); the operator must name the sources fitted to this model

operator_required.name: trigger_level
operator_required.reason: the manual says an out-of-range trigger level is adjusted to the closest legal value (resources/maui_text.txt:4818) and states no numeric bound; the level range depends on the trigger source, so the operator must supply the window

safe_state.description: acquisition STOP sent and TRMD? read back as stopped; no external circuit or WaveSource generator is stopped, and another client or the front panel can resume acquisition
